In a browser, mostly on phones
As an installed phone app
As an installed desktop app

ops.question: Do you start with existing data?

options.label: Start empty
Import from a spreadsheet/CSV once
Migrate from another tool

ops.question: Do people need to get their data out?

options.label: No
Download lists as CSV/Excel
Full export and/or an API

ops.question: When something is deleted, what really happens?

options.label: It's gone
It's archived and can be restored
Records are never deleted, only voided/cancelled

ops.question: How much data will there be?

options.label: Hundreds of records
Tens of thousands
Millions

ops.question: Does it need to connect to other tools?

options.label: No
A few key ones (e.g., accounting, payments, calendar)
Many — it needs a public API / webhooks

ops.question: Languages and regions?

options.label: One language, one country
Several languages
Several countries (taxes, formats, currencies)

ops.question: Can files/photos be attached to things?

options.label: No
Yes — upload and download
Yes — with previews, versions, and sharing

ops.question: Do some actions need someone else's approval first?

options.label: No
One approver
Multi-step approval chains

ops.question: Must anything happen automatically on a schedule?

options.label: No
Only reminders/notifications
Records get created automatically (recurring invoices, appointments, reports)

ops.question: Does it hold data with special legal handling (health, payment cards, minors)?

options.label: Ordinary business data
Personal data needing consent/retention care (GDPR-like)
Regulated data (health, cards, finance)

ops.question: How long is data kept?

options.label: Until someone deletes it
Auto-removed after a set period
Each business sets its own policy

ops.question: Can each business customize the app?

options.label: No — everyone gets the same thing
Branding and templates (logo, colors, wording)
Custom fields and workflows

ops.question: What do people need to see across many records?

options.label: Sortable, filterable lists
A dashboard with totals and counts
Custom reports people build themselves

ops.question: Are records grouped into separate projects/workspaces, or is it one shared pool?

options.label: One shared pool — everything lives in one place with filters
Separate projects/workspaces, each with its own members

ops.question: Who can see a record?

options.label: Everyone in the team sees everything
Records are private to their owner unless shared or assigned
Visible within the owner's team/department; admins see all

ops.question: Who can change a record?

options.label: Anyone who can see it can edit it
Only its owner/assignee and admins; others just view
Set per record: view / comment / edit

ops.question: Are the fields on a record fixed, or can admins add their own?

options.label: Fixed — the same fields for everyone
Admins add custom fields (text, number, date, dropdown) to each record type
Admins define whole new record types with their own fields

ops.question: Are records linked to each other?

options.label: No — each record stands alone
Yes — records of different types reference each other (contact → company → deal)
Yes — including parent/child trees (projects → tasks → sub-tasks)

ops.question: Should the app do things on its own when records change?

options.label: No — people do everything by hand
Simple rules: when X happens, notify/assign/change stage
Multi-step workflows with conditions and delays

ops.question: Can two records be the same thing (same email, same serial number)?

options.label: Allowed — nothing stops duplicates
The app warns about likely duplicates and offers to merge
A key field must be unique; duplicates are rejected

ops.question: How do people find a record?

options.label: Filter and sort within each list
One search box across all record types
Search that also looks inside comments and attachments

ops.question: Can people change many records at once?

options.label: No — one record at a time
Yes — select many and assign/move/tag/delete together

ops.question: What happens when a Bookkeeper deletes/renames an Account that already has Transactions and Budgets attached?

options.label: Block deletion while any transaction/budget references it
Force reassigning transactions to another account first
Soft-archive the account but keep historical postings intact

ops.question: If the same Import File (or a re-upload of the same month) is submitted twice, what happens?

options.label: Detect by name/hash/period and reject the duplicate
Replace the prior import for that period
Append rows, allowing duplicates

ops.question: How are negative amounts, refunds/credits, and rounding handled so reports stay balanced?

options.label: Store signed integer cents; allow negatives; no rounding
Round only for display, keep full precision internally
Reject negative/zero amounts entirely

ops.question: How is the Period a Transaction belongs to determined (e.g. a Mar 31 late-night entry, or a backdated invoice)?

options.label: By the transaction's own date field, fixed org timezone
By the period declared on the import file
Bookkeeper assigns the period explicitly

ops.question: If an Import File passes some rows but fails reconciliation or has bad rows, what state is saved?

options.label: Reject the whole file until it fully reconciles
Load into staging; nothing hits reports until Finance Manager accepts
Commit good rows, flag the bad ones

ops.question: Can a closed Period be reopened or an approved Monthly Report be un-approved?

options.label: No — closed/approved is final
Finance Manager may reopen, logged in the audit trail
Reopening creates a new versioned revision of the period/report

ops.question: How is cross-department or delegated access handled (e.g. a Department Head covering another, or Owner drilling into raw transactions)?

options.label: Strict — each head sees only their own department, no delegation
Finance Manager can grant temporary cross-department view
Owner sees all details; heads strictly scoped

ops.question: When a new import updates figures that were also manually entered (a2) for the same accounts/period, which wins?

options.label: Import is authoritative and overwrites manual entries
Manual entries are preserved; import only adds new rows
Conflicts are flagged for Finance Manager review
